proposed.summary_zh: SkillForge 同时训练模型并维护外部技能库。它根据执行回报和失败轨迹生成子技能；试用技能达到使用次数门槛后转为活跃状态，稳定与退休再按表现和使用次数管理，更新后的技能库用于后续检索。它符合模型与 Harness 共演化；共享任务回报并不能单独确认每个技能的因果贡献，且教师会带入外部知识。
proposed.summary_en: SkillForge trains the model while maintaining an external skill library. Execution rewards and failure trajectories guide child-skill generation. Trial skills become active after a usage threshold; fitness and usage govern stabilization and retirement, and later rollouts retrieve from the revised library. This supports a model-and-Harness coevolution classification. Shared task rewards do not isolate each skill’s causal contribution, and the teacher can introduce external knowledge.

items.reason: Make usage-only trial-to-active transition explicit; preserve coevolution scope and all source facts.
Multiple independent single-model runs do not establish transfer of the evolved artifact between models.
